paper.title: SkillWeaver: Web Agents can Self-Improve by Discovering and Honing Skills
paper.central_claim: 自主提出网站练习任务、从成功轨迹合成并honing可复用API，持续扩张技能库，提高WebArena/真实网站成功率并向弱agent迁移。
paper.scope: A类：执行反馈修改并留存Python技能API、docstring与使用日志，后续任务调用；非权重更新。

provenance.notes: 派发sonnet→gpt-6.1-sol；无独立模型调用receipt/session信息，依模板null。无运行论文代码、外部检索或其他席/批次结果访问。领域卡只消费机制条件，未以成员结果/录用统计评分。

sections_read: 全文Abstract、§1–6、伦理声明、Tables1–2、Figures1–10图注、Appendix A.1–A.8全部prompt、B完整任务数、C全部57任务列表、D.1–D.4全部程序/失败案例、HTML末尾；无page_images，不推断图中未转录数值

evidence.quote: In our work, “API” refers to a Python function containing Playwright code for a browser automation, rather than a (for example) REST API that handles HTTP requests.
evidence.support_explanation: 留存对象为网页自动化Python函数。

evidence.quote: Both methods also focus on online learning with access to test queries or offline learning requiring high-quality annotated demonstrations. Instead, we focus on more challenging autonomous exploration where agents propose novel tasks without external supervision.
evidence.support_explanation: 作者将AWM/ICAL与自主练习区别；未独立核邻文。

evidence.quote: we emphasize skill diversity by explicitly prompting LLMs to propose novel and reusable skills beyond the current skill repertoire.
evidence.support_explanation: 根据当前库提出新短程练习，不等同证明边际能力增加。

evidence.quote: (3) Environmental feedback, including code execution outcomes and observable website changes.
evidence.support_explanation: 实践reward有任务、轨迹、截图和执行/环境信号，由LLM判断。

evidence.quote: each API includes a Python implementation (including a function signature, docstring, and code body), where the docstring particularly contains a usage log recording previous executions of the function and a description of the prerequisite state of the website for the function to execute without errors.
evidence.support_explanation: 参数化实现及前置状态/日志留存。

evidence.quote: For APIs requiring additional parameters, we leverage the LLM to generate appropriate parameter values that serve as comprehensive test cases.
evidence.support_explanation: 生成额外测试输入并debug，但覆盖性未实证。

evidence.quote: iterations with GPT-4o, where an iteration is defined as either attempting a proposed skill or testing an existing skill. Within each iteration, the agent proposes either a procedural or navigational task at the starting webpage.
evidence.support_explanation: 每网站160iterations，iteration可能是新实践或旧技能测试，非160成功技能。

evidence.quote: During exploration, the agent can access APIs synthesized in the previous exploration steps after skill selection to compose more complex APIs.
evidence.support_explanation: 练习跨轮调用/组合已有函数。

evidence.quote: Once the exploration process is completed, the synthesized API library can be reused to expand and enhance the action space of other agents capable of API calling.
evidence.support_explanation: 探索结束后保留库，GPT4o-mini测试只换backbone。

evidence.quote: To ensure the validity of evaluation, we manually evaluate the success of agent trajectories.
evidence.support_explanation: 真实网站57任务人工最终评估；无多标注者一致率。

evidence.quote: For the Car website, while the final success rate remained unchanged after incorporating synthesized APIs, we observed that in four out of nine tasks, the synthesized APIs successfully guided the agent to the final state required for task completion.
evidence.support_explanation: Cars最终成功率不变，局部接近不能算最终成功。

evidence.quote: Here is the fix the agent made: removing the ambiguous DOM selector for “textbox”, and replacing it with one that first selects the dialog window that contains the textbox, and then the textbox element within it.
evidence.support_explanation: 执行strict-mode失败定位并改持久API，不是仅当前回答纠错。

evidence.quote: Because our criteria for a function to be “verified” was to have it be called without producing an exception, we found that occasionally, malfunctioning APIs could be marked as verified simply because they silenced all exceptions that could have occurred. This represents a measure for evaluation having unintended consequences.
evidence.support_explanation: 作者直接承认honing的无异常验证会奖励无效/静默API；不冒称语义验证。

evidence.quote: While this does reduce the number of exceptions, it does not improve the robustness of the API.
evidence.support_explanation: 减少异常不等于更robust。

evidence.quote: Some skills require interacting with data stored on the website, and their success is conditioned not on whether the UI is accurately interacted with but rather whether the function inputs are realistic.
evidence.support_explanation: 真实测试输入不可得会使功能无法核验。

evidence.quote: On websites with high API support, such as GitLab and Maps, the performance of the synthesized APIs is not as good.
evidence.support_explanation: 对高API支持站点不及人工API，保留负结果。

evidence.quote: We identify two primary categories of failures: (1) failure to identify the appropriate API and (2) generating wrong parameters.
evidence.support_explanation: 库的产生不等于正确使用，检索/参数是实际边界。

evidence.quote: During online evaluation, we noticed the possibility of these web agents generating harmful actions on the web, and we manually validated the safety of all the actions before execution.
evidence.support_explanation: 真实网站执行有人工安全门；不能外推完全无人工开放部署。

evidence.quote: tasks, each with automated evaluation metrics based on functional correctness.
evidence.support_explanation: WebArena最终任务评价不同于honing无异常门。
表中GPT4o平均22.6→29.8%；约31.9%相对提升（未舍入值可对应31.8%）；§4.1把WebArena写39.8%与此不符。
GPT4o-mini平均9.2→14.1%，表中AVG Δ45%与显示均值比值约53.3%不符；正文54.3%可能基于未舍入加权值，不能据此确定45%的来源。

evidence.quote:
WebArena benchmark include the following tasks:

•

Gitlab: 180 tasks

•

Map: 109 tasks

•

Shopping: 187 tasks

•

CMS: 182 tasks

•

Reddit: 106 tasks
evidence.support_explanation: 五域任务数180+109+187+182+106=764，与正文812不等；可能未含跨域但本文未明确结果分母覆盖。

signatures.object: 网站特定Python/Playwright API库与docstring/usage log
signatures.information: 截图、URL、a11y tree、当前技能与semantic knowledge；自主任务而非外部test query
signatures.operation: 提出短程procedural/navigation或scraping任务→实践至LLM判成功→轨迹抽象成参数化函数→静态检查→生成参数测试/执行调试→保留API和使用日志→按任务检索并注入signature/docstring→调用或组合
signatures.output: 可调用、可跨backbone复用的技能文件
signatures.conditions: 网站可安全实践，练习覆盖未来子程序；执行无异常必须真实对应功能而非静默skip；参数有效且前置状态匹配
signatures.feedback: LLM对任务完成判断、traceback、网站变化、scraping结果与HTML对照；API verified实际有无异常门缺陷
signatures.selection_rule: 成功实践才生成；语法/接口错误再生成；honing无异常验证能误收silent-noop，无独立效用/回归/退库门控
signatures.selection_data: 每网站160轮自主实践/旧API测试；非评测查询驱动，未提供显式重叠审计
signatures.persistence: 函数实现、前置状态、usage log保留到后续实践和评测
signatures.later_use: 固定库扩张GPT4o/GPT4o-mini动作空间，后续复用、组合及修补
signatures.claimed_effect: 成功率提高、可移植知识/技能与更可靠API
signatures.failure_boundary: 静默失败伪验证、假测试参数、检索不调用/参数错、强基座天花板、网站特定知识而非同API跨站转移

gap.author_gap: 轨迹内隐技能难抽象/组合/共享，AWM/ICAL依赖test query或示范；需在新站自主练习构建API。
gap.checked_gap: 保留可执行程序、主动练习与强到弱固定库复用有具体支持；同类非参数库已有Voyager/Friday等，不能将函数库视作首次创新。
